# Graph operations · data

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### data.collect



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `keys` | `array<string>` | Required | {"items":"string"} |
| Output | `value` | `array` | — |  |

- All requested keys must exist in the input record.

Guides: [guide](../field-sprite-materials.md#build-a-material-slot), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#layers-depth-and-height), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#drawing-layout-and-regions), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#procedural-generation-and-recipes), [guide](../material-shape-splatter.md#shape-sources)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe data.collect --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### data.get



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `record` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `key` | `string` | Required |  |
| Output | `value` | `any` | — |  |

- The key must exist in the input record.

### data.record



Origin: toolkit.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `label` | `any` | Required |  |
| Input | `count` | `any` | Required |  |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

### data.typed



Origin: toolkit.
The declared graph type becomes the type of the value input and output.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `value` | `number` | Required | {"finite":true} |
| Output | `value` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#legacy-and-shared-port-shapes), [guide](../physical-audio.md#build-an-audio-graph), [guide](../reusable-function-graphs.md#value-nodes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe data.typed --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
